clue.text: Unjustified when beginning to exult in praise

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its opening letter, so only that one is kept
the short pieces are placed inside the longer word that follows

blocks.note: to bless is to praise, as in blessing God
as in 'as I arrived', meaning when
opening letter of exult

explanation.surface: Someone is criticised for starting to crow while being congratulated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When' looks like a time word in the story, but it stands for AS, as in 'as I arrived'.
explanation.definitionFit: A claim without any basis or foundation is groundless, hence not justified.

clue.text: Mass in depth grasped by child

blocks.note: a boy is a male child
d is the standard abbreviation for depth

explanation.surface: A child clutches something heavy that sits deep down.

clue.text: Seekers in vault taken in by prophets

explanation.definitionFit: Plural nouns for people who hunt or look for something, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Los Angeles artist admitting very immature form

explanation.walkthrough: RA stands for Royal Academician, a member of Britain's Royal Academy of Arts.

clue.text: Unhappily abstain, lust being considerable

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone grudgingly gives up a great deal of desire.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something large in amount or size, so they are close synonyms.

clue.text: Unpleasant, chased by police

explanation.walkthrough: CID is the plain-clothes detective branch of a British police force.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancid literally describes stale, foul-smelling fat, and more loosely anything nasty or offensive.

clue.text: Steward at start of trip unusually tanned

arranged in an unusual way, the letters do not keep their normal order

blocks.note: taken as written
opening letter of trip
taken as written

clue.text: Surprise in contract

second meaning: to pick up an illness

explanation.walkthrough: Contract suggests a legal document, but here it is the verb used of illness.
explanation.definitionFit: You can catch a thief in the act, surprising them, and catch a cold, contracting it.

clue.text: Resolve, endlessly receiving pressure, at this point cracked

a word receiving others takes them inside itself

p is the symbol for pressure in physics

explanation.surface: Under strain, someone's resolve finally breaks at this moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cracked' looks like part of the story of breaking under pressure, but it is the definition, as in cracking a code.
explanation.definitionFit: Cracking a code or cipher means working it out, which is exactly what deciphering it does.

explanation.definitionFit: A diatribe is a bitter spoken or written denunciation, a tirade of abuse against someone.

clue.text: Excited fans stir champ to show skill

explanation.definitionFit: Craftsmanship is the expertise or artistry of a skilled maker, so it names a kind of skill.

taken as written

clue.text: Approval for each assignment

explanation.definitionFit: An eye-opener is a surprising revelation, something that makes you see things afresh.

clue.text: Passage in article with silly lies

blocks.note: the indefinite article
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: An aisle is a walkway between rows of seats, a passage through a church, plane or shop.

last letter of alone

blocks.note: taken as written
